factual_fidelity.evidence: 'parquet en chêne' invents oak species (input only says 'parquet flooring'); 'poêle à bois' (wood stove) contradicts input 'fireplace' / 'wood-burning fireplace'.

completeness.evidence: Covers 'villa individuelle de 280 m²', 'cinq chambres', 'trois salles de bains', Strassen, jardin, terrasse, cave, parking, îlot, double four, SW.

native_quality.evidence: 'agencement fonctionnel avec plans de travail en granite' reads as native French real-estate prose.

market_fit.evidence: 'villa individuelle', 'suite principale', 'cave', 'stationnement' match LU FR portal lexicon.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class invented; description omits energy class as no class was supplied.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Villa rénovée 5 chambres avec jardin mature et terrasses à Strassen' is 11 words with neighborhood; 5 CamelCase hashtags.

tone_discipline.evidence: 'invite à la convivialité' and 'équilibre entre authenticité et modernité' are mildly marketing but no exclamation or 'à couper le souffle'.

hallucination.evidence: 'écoles renommées à proximité' invents reputation of schools, and 'bon accès aux axes autoroutiers' invents motorway proximity not in inputs.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: DE/EN/FR all agree on 280 m², 5 beds, 3 baths, SW garden, parking, cellar, terrace; however FR uniquely calls the fireplace 'poêle à bois' (wood stove) while DE/EN say 'Kamin'/'wood-burning fireplace', a minor feature mismatch.
